chunks: 6 - Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: 'Ali b. al-Husayn al-Sa'dabadi narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Abi 'Abdillah al-Barqi narrated to us from his father from Muhammad b. Ziyad from Aban and others from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad (peace be upon them both). He said:

Whoever completes his fast with a good saying or a good action, Allah will accept his fast. So it was said to him: O son of the Messenger of Allah, what is the good saying? He said: The testimony that there is no god but Allah; and the good action is giving out [zakat] al-Fitra.

key_terms.شَهَادَة: Shahadah: testimony of faith, declaring that there is no god but Allah
key_terms.فِطْرَة: Zakat al-Fitra: obligatory charity given at the end of Ramadan before Eid prayer

ai.seo_question: How should one seal their fast according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) teaches that one should complete their fast with a good saying or a good action for Allah to accept the fast. When asked what constitutes a good saying, the Imam explained it is the shahadah (testimony that there is no god but Allah). The good action is giving zakat al-Fitra. This connects the spiritual act of fasting with both affirmation of faith and charitable giving at the end of Ramadan.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa al-Mutawakkil (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. al-Husayn al-Sa`d al-Abidi narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah al-Barqi narrated to us from his father from Muhammad b. Ziyad from Aban and someone else from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as). He said:

Whoever completes his fast with a good saying or a good action, Allah will accept his fast. So, it was said to him: O son of the Messenger of Allah! What is the good saying? He said: The testimony that there is no god but Allah; and the good action is giving out [zakat] al-Fitra.
